verdict.rationale: Exporting data in open formats to leave is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, but the evidence pack documents no bulk or full-account data export feature and names no open export formats. The GraphQL Developer API with introspection is only a developer building block that someone could use to construct an extraction, and 'audit-ready reports' is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
